headline: PREMIER LEAGUE IS BACK!!! After 21 long days!
body: I am so happy I could cry. My life is shitty right now. And I am so glad I can forget everything and just watch 22 men running behind a ball. I am a United fan so looking forward to the United vs Spurs match. Will we become the new Spurs? Or will Spurs remain at the bottom of the board? But I will also be watching Villa vs Brentford. Should be a good game. And I am absolutely super excited for Liverpool vs City on Sunday. I hope the Liverpool team and fans give it to them well and good!   submitted by   /u/inspired_nobita [link]   [comments]
